note: Bexsero 為 Meningococcal Group B 疫苗，與四價接合型（Menveo）不同類，矩陣以獨立列「腦膜炎雙球菌 B 型疫苗」呈現。

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
BEXSERO (Meningococcal Group B Vaccine) is a sterile, white, opalescent, injectable
suspension for intramuscular use.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
50 mcg each of recombinant proteins Neisserial adhesin A (NadA), Neisserial Heparin Binding
Antigen (NHBA), and factor H binding protein (fHbp), and 25 mcg of Outer Membrane Vesicles
(OMV), 1.5 mg aluminum hydroxide (0.519 mg of Al3+), 3.125 mg sodium chloride, 0.776 mg
histidine, and 10 mg sucrose at pH 6.4 to 6.7.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote: Each dose contains less than 0.01 mcg kanamycin (by calculation).

allergens.quote: Each dose contains less than 0.01 mcg kanamycin (by calculation).

The tip cap and rubber plunger stopper of the prefilled syringe are not made with natural rubber
latex.
1.5 mg aluminum hydroxide (0.519 mg of Al3+)

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote:
Do not administer BEXSERO to individuals with a history of a severe allergic reaction (e.g.,
anaphylaxis) to any component of BEXSERO or after a previous dose of BEXSERO

warnings.label: Latex
warnings.quote:
The tip cap and rubber plunger stopper of the prefilled syringe are not made with natural rubber
latex.
